## Summary

Describe the user-visible outcome and why it is needed.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests were added or updated for behavior changes.
- [ ] Documentation was added or updated where needed.
- [ ] `npm run check` passes.
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes.
- [ ] No generated artifacts, secrets, or private configuration are included.
- [ ] Existing MIT license text and third-party attribution are preserved.
